Privacy notice

Last updated: October 2026

Who is responsible

EMOVE Profe is run by eMove Academy (Barcelona, Spain). Contact: emovecourses@gmail.com.

What we collect

  • The details you give when you request access: name, email, school, country, role, stage, subject and interests.
  • Your password, stored only in encrypted form.
  • Your progress on the platform: completed activities, notes, saved resources, quiz results, certificates and the eMove courses you open.

Why we use it

  • To review your request and manage your access.
  • To keep your progress in sync across your devices.
  • To understand how the platform is used and improve it.
  • Only if you tick the box: to send you news about Erasmus+ deadlines and eMove courses. You can change this in your profile at any time.

Where it is stored

Your account is stored with our hosting provider (Netlify). Your browser also keeps a local copy of your progress so the platform works offline. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

How long we keep it

While your account is active. Ask us to delete your account at any time and we will erase your details and progress.

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or object to its use, by writing to emovecourses@gmail.com. You can also complain to your data protection authority.
